ModMetaData.name: Raiders Have Families
ModMetaData.author: Pavuchicha
ModMetaData.description: Raiders Have Families 0.3.1 DEV TEST for RimWorld 1.7. Expanded families, a nine-tier social/political rank system, hostage negotiations and faction retaliation. Separate assault and tactical prison-rescue responses, optional field extraction pod prototype, exact optional WCE2 surgery integration. Event-driven Harmony 3. Adds developer Actions for direct assault, rescue, VIP/pod prototype, coalition, hired raiders, tribal animals, and high-tech retaliation. Advanced scenarios remain experimental. Back up saves before testing.
